name: Acqua di Gio
description: Acqua di Gio by Giorgio Armani is a legendary aquatic fragrance launched in 1996 that defined the fresh, marine genre. Inspired by the beauty of Pantelleria, a Mediterranean island where Armani spent his vacations, this scent captures the essence of sea, sun, and freedom. It remains one of the top-selling men's fragrances decades after its release.
